name: Add and complete an assignment
description: Verifies a student can add an assignment, mark it complete, and retain the result after refresh.
steps: Add an assignment named 'PHP Exam' with a future deadline
Mark 'PHP Exam' complete and refresh the page
expected: 'PHP Exam' remains visible with a completed status after refresh.

name: Add an exam and update grade progress
description: Verifies exam planning and grade progress are reflected in the dashboard.
steps: Add an exam named 'Maths' with a date and target score of 80
expected: The Maths exam is listed and the progress view reflects the saved study record.

name: Reject an incomplete assignment
description: Verifies required assignment information is validated before saving.
expected: A validation message appears and no blank assignment is created.

name: Manage a course and its study progress
description: Verifies a course can be created and its progress updated.
expected: Web Development remains listed with 60 percent progress.
